caption_en:
One of these three stocks never fell more than 15% in 63 years. Guess which before the end.

If countries were stocks: GDP per person, current US$, World Bank, 1960 to 2025.

Stock A: $718 in 1960. Oil boom: $28,703 in 1981 (40x in 21 years). Bust: $9,166 by 1988 (down 68%). Back above the 1981 peak only in 2012. 2025: $34,537.
Stock B: $156 in 1960, $3,086 in 2025.
Stock C: $1,452 in 1960. Since 1962, never down more than 15% (worst: 1983 to 1985, down 14%). 2025: $60,337.

Stock A grew the most in percent. Stock C ends highest.

The reveal: A is Saudi Arabia. B is Egypt. C, with almost no oil or gas income (natural resource rents 0.4% of GDP, 2021), is Israel.

No oil isn't the secret on its own: Jordan (0.1%) and Lebanon (0.0%) have almost none either.

Current US$, not adjusted for inflation or prices. Not a stock, not a forecast, not financial advice.

Sources: World Bank, World Development Indicators: GDP per capita (current US$, NY.GDP.PCAP.CD) and total natural resource rents (% of GDP, NY.GDP.TOTL.RT.ZS), accessed Nov 2026. Photos: Khurais oil field, Planet Labs, CC BY-SA 4.0; Intel Kiryat Gat, Kiryat Gat archive, CC BY 2.5; Hatzeva, Negev 1971, Moshe Milner, GPO (PD). Made with AI tools, AI voice (Noam's cloned voice), follow line in Noam's own voice.
caption_he:
3 מניות מסתוריות. 65 שנה. באיזו הייתם בוחרים?
התמ"ג לנפש (הבנק העולמי, דולרים שוטפים):
מניה A: 718 דולר ב-1960, 28,703 ב-1981, ואז קריסה של 68% עד 1988. רק ב-2012 חזרה לשיא. היום 34,537.
מניה B: 156 דולר ב-1960, 3,086 היום.
מניה C: 1,452 דולר ב-1960. מאז 1962 אף פעם לא ירדה ביותר מ-15%. היום 60,337.
A היא סעודיה. B היא מצרים. C, כמעט בלי הכנסות מנפט וגז, היא ישראל.
לא מניה, לא תחזית, לא ייעוץ השקעות.

lines.line: Three mystery stocks. Sixty five years. Pick one.
Each stock is a country's income per person, since 1960.
Stock A starts at seven hundred dollars.
Then it rockets. Forty times in twenty one years.
Then it crashes. Down sixty eight percent in seven years.
It takes thirty one years to climb back.
Today, about thirty four thousand dollars.
Stock B starts at one hundred fifty six dollars, and climbs slowly to about three thousand.
Stock C starts at fourteen hundred dollars.
Since 1962, it never falls more than fifteen percent.
Stock A grew the most. But what a ride.
The reveal. Stock A is Saudi Arabia, the oil stock.
No oil isn't the secret on its own. Jordan and Lebanon have almost none either.
If you love Israeli facts, follow Noam Roz for more.
And stock C, with almost no oil at all? Israel. Would you have picked it?
